The cosine conjugacy yields exactly B expanding full rectangular branches and a generating uniform Bernoulli coding; this establishes entropy, maximal-entropy uniqueness and measure isomorphism. Arcsine Chebyshev orthogonality establishes the general mode-correlation formula and the one-step parameter signature. An independent finite rational/SymPy checker executed successfully on the actual packaged code; it is not used as an infinite proof. Boundary coding exceptions are entropy-zero and do not challenge maximal-entropy uniqueness.

value.rationale: This supplies a complete periodic-orbit census and measure-theoretic classification for a natural chaotic-source map, with a precise observability hierarchy: stationary one-time marginals and all ordinary lagged cross-correlations are degree-blind, periodic data and maximal entropy isolate only the degree product, and a nonlinear one-step Chebyshev statistic recovers each ordered parameter. The contrast identifies an inherent limitation of familiar statistical comparisons without making an unsupported cryptographic-security claim. It applies to every integer triple, not a manufactured finite parameter slice.
